leadText: Miyuki Sawashiro (Japanese: 沢城みゆき Sawashiro Miyuki), is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Miyuki Sawashiro (Japanese: 沢城みゆき Sawashiro Miyuki), is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Sawashiro was born on June 2, 1985 in , and became a voice actress as an adult. Sawashiro started out voicing Marley and various characters of the day during and , respectively. Her most prominent role was Olivia, one of the island kahunas, in . Sawashiro was once affiliated with before she switched to . In 2014, she announced her marriage.
